_comment: design-sync build tsconfig. Only compilerOptions.paths is read (by the
converter's esbuild resolve plugin, lib/bundle.mjs tsconfigPathsPlugin) —
it maps the repo's `@/` alias plus the modules that have no meaning
outside a Next.js server onto the shims in ./shims/.
esbuild picks up jsx/target from the repo's own tsconfig.json, which is
why this file deliberately does not restate them.
ORDER MATTERS: the resolver returns on first match, so the specific
@/lib/blog entry must stay above the @/* wildcard or it never fires.
